question: Which temporal/frequency components of the TRAIN24 feasibility teacher improve frozen SO3 posture, and which are reduced by the DC penalty?
scope: Use locked TRAIN_C5_24 inputs and existing teacher, no-DC OOF, and DC-penalty OOF action artifacts only. No VAL/TEST, Plant, or inertia reconstruction.

fixed_diagnostics.band_task_protocol: For the feasibility teacher only, inject each zero-phase filtered action-correction band alone on the frozen C5 TRAIN trajectory and score SO3; compare the no-DC/DC students by their full-action time replay and correction spectra. Report as a non-additive diagnostic, not a controller rollout.

decision_rule: Choose one prespecified training objective after this TRAIN-only descriptive analysis; do not tune its weights/windows on held-out folds and do not claim closed-loop Q from these metrics.
